title: Question 6.2c: Confusion Matrix - Counting in Loop
instruction: This code loops through each prediction result and counts how many times each combination of actual and predicted values occurs.
reveal: This loop goes through each prediction result. For each row, it extracts the actual label and predicted label, then increments the count in the matrix at position [actual][predicted]. For example, if actual=1 (positive) and predicted=1 (positive), it increments matrix[1][1], which counts correct positive predictions. The `++` operator adds 1 to the current count.
